levels.label: Governance: can it be demonstrated?

scenes.caption: Each layer measures a distance between a claim and reality.
say: Three companies, three layers, one shape: a promise on one side, behaviour on the other.
Two are from their own public pages; RiskMandate's part is what we would do together.

scenes.title: Governance that can be demonstrated

before.label: Where many SMEs start
items: Using AI, unsure about the risks

after.label: Where the check aims
items: 'We can demonstrate our AI is governed operationally and defensibly'
A governance score, an executive snapshot, a board report

scenes.caption: Their words: practical, defensible outputs in days instead of months.
say: Sustain-Nobility's check moves an organisation from belief to demonstration.
It serves SMEs, and partners supporting hundreds of SMEs with one tool.

scenes.title: What a site says against what it does
steps: Load the site like a first-time EU visitor
scenes.caption: Its EU Consent Index: of 160 sites, 69% loaded trackers or non-essential cookies before consent; 58% kept tracking after Reject (where Reject could be completed).
say: A free scan, about 4 minutes, no sign-up.
The index shows the gap between banner and behaviour is common.
scenes.source: Cycubix / ConsentScan public pages, EU Consent Index (2 Nov 2026)

scenes.title: Claim, reality, and the measured gap
rows: What each agent is asked to do
What it can reach: credentials, tools, data
Trackers that fire, before and after Reject
scenes.caption: RiskMandate's row is our hypothesis from public pages; nothing of theirs was tested.
say: Lay the three side by side and the structure repeats.
Cycubix's phrase 'installed, not blocking' has the same shape as an agent policy that exists but is not enforced.
scenes.source: Public pages of both companies; RiskMandate hypothesis

scenes.title: With Sustain-Nobility
items: Mandate: a readiness check already writes down what each AI system is for and who is accountable
Reach: public pages do not say how agents' credentials, tools and data are measured: unknown
Gap: measured per agent, read-only, as a written record
Their assessments ask for evidence; we would produce it
scenes.caption: Our hypothesis, not their claim. Built from public pages only.
say: This is what we would do together, not something Sustain-Nobility says.
The gap between mandate and reach would be the demonstration for agentic AI.
scenes.source: RiskMandate hypothesis from Sustain-Nobility public pages

scenes.title: With Cycubix and ConsentScan
items: Mandate: the scanner's job is narrow and writable: load a site, record cookies, click Reject, grade
Reach: the MCP server lets Claude, Cursor or any MCP client run scans; what its credentials reach beyond scanning is unknown
Gap: unknown from public pages, but a narrow mandate makes it measurable
We would write the mandate, measure the reach, record the gap
scenes.caption: Our hypothesis, not their claim. Nothing of theirs was tested.
say: ConsentScan's MCP server is an outside agent with a tool: a clean place to start.
The unknowns are the point: we would measure them, not assume them.
scenes.source: RiskMandate hypothesis from Cycubix public pages

scenes.text: Governance you can demonstrate, agents measured against their mandate, sites measured against their word: one gap, three layers, measured.
scenes.caption: Three layers, one habit: write down the claim, then measure the distance.
say: From 'we think' to 'we can demonstrate' needs a measurement at every layer.
That is the joint story we would like to build.
